item.title: Bitbucket CLI
item.summary: My company is forcing me to use Bitbucket, no way move to Github and I do miss the Github cli. I don't know why Atlassian won't pay enough love for the CLI world? it forces you into using Rovo cli $$$$ So, I built a framework that takes their OpenAPI file and wrap it as a cli, the results are great so far. Ofc it's unofficial https://github.com/scr2em/bitbucket-cli Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49270776 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
